payload.summary: Native Git discovery passed the 51-case suite, all three CI platforms, browser and clean package smoke, plus the installed raw-git.exe status bootstrap without profiles. Capability probes are isolated from the live collector and disappeared temporary worktrees are drained safely. Machine discovery is configured and running. Ready to publish v0.3.0.
payload.next: Publish v0.3.0 and use ordinary native Git commands to adopt unmonitored projects.
